result:
Untagged thread replies now prompt the thread creator when they haven't chosen a follow-up setting, instead of being dropped. I haven't run the tests.

`resolve_untagged_followup_mode` in `products/slack_app/backend/services/slack_settings.py` now returns `ASK` when there is no settings row, the column is empty, or the stored value is no longer recognised. It still returns `NEVER` when the thread has no creator to ask. Explicit `auto`, `ask` and `never` choices are unchanged.

`api.py` needed no change. The webhook only drops replies when the mode is `NEVER`, so unset creators' replies now go on to the workflow. The workflow's existing `ask` handling then posts the prompt after the classifier judges the reply worth forwarding.

I updated the docstring in `slack_settings.py` and the comments in `models.py` to match. I also changed the expectations in `test_slack_settings.py` and `test_thread_message_routing.py` so unset resolves to `ASK` and the webhook dispatches. I added one case for a missing creator resolving to `NEVER`.

I did not touch the Home tab. Its follow-ups card reads the same resolver, so it should now show "Ask them first" for people who never chose. I didn't check that rendering or run its tests.
